thread.title: Unity Rules Engine Development
thread.preview:
**I agree with the authored evidence/method IDs and nondestructive scope. Use the following three NEW provisional completions under our delegated process.** The sources establish the procedures, but do not unambiguously settle these boundaries.

**1. Research and copying retain feasible completed work after interruption.**

[FL-03](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/c5cca832e082ed56e477e15188e6cbbf163a5f7c/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/expedition/EXPEDITION_PLAYER_BOOK.md#L56) preserves feasible unfinished work while respecting procedure-specific exceptions. [Crafting line 53](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/c5cca832e082ed56e477e15188e6cbbf163a5f7c/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CRAFTING_HARVEST_PLAYTEST.md#L53) supplies phase loss, but its extension to these knowledge-only procedures is ambiguous.

**NEW scoped completion:**

- Nondestructive formula research and ordinary copying retain actual eligible progress through voluntary pause, forced interruption and save/resume.
- Resume the same attempt after revalidating worker capability, evidence access and its legal work window.
- No partial formula acquisition, completion check or XP arises from interruption.
- Explicit destruction or another source-defined consequence remains separately applicable; interruption alone destroys neither notes nor progress.
- Deliberate cancellation closes the attempt. Preserve its history and notes, but do not transfer its labor credit into a fresh attempt.

Record this as a **knowledge-only exception**. Manufacturing still uses its native phase-loss rule. Research/copying does not need artificial eight-hour uninterrupted phases merely because Watches are eight hours.

**2. A retry requires the full research duration; the eight different-method hours count within it.**

The [research paragraph](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/c5cca832e082ed56e477e15188e6cbbf163a5f7c/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CRAFTING_HARVEST_PLAYTEST.md#L174) supplies both `H = max(8, minimumResearchHours)` and the changed-evidence/different-method retry requirement. Their composition needs completion.

**NEW completion: every fresh attempt requires H newly performed active hours.**

| Retry route after a failed 20-hour attempt | Required new work |
|---|---|
| New qualifying source/sample | 20 hours |
| Same evidence, concretely different method | 20 hours, including at least eight hours actually using that different method |

Thus the second route takes **20 additional hours**, not eight or 28. The first attempt’s 20 hours remain historical expenditure; its notes do not become labor credit toward the retry.

Declare the alternative method before its work begins. The completion check requires both the full duration and the eight-hour method requirement. Those hours count once, after the preceding failure. Renaming a method or cycling between already-failed methods on unchanged evidence does not establish a new method; eligibility must come from the authored substantive distinction.

For Recipe-4’s supplied binding, `H=8`: a same-evidence retry therefore requires eight new hours of the qualifying different method.

This preserves the formula’s research duration without adding an unstated eight-hour preparation surcharge.

**3. Copying consumes its writing supplies when actual work begins.**

The source fixes **one hour and 1 sp of writing supplies**, but gives no debit/refund boundary.

**NEW completion:**

| State change | Supplies and progress |
|---|---|
| Schedule/reserve only | Reserve the actual writing-supply allotment; consume nothing. |
| First positive interval of copying work | Consume the whole allotment once, atomically with recording that work began. |
| Pause/forced interruption | Retain progress; no refund and no second charge on resume. |
| Cancel before any work | Release the reservation. |
| Cancel after work began | No supply or time refund; no completed formula. A fresh copying order requires fresh supplies and its full hour. |
| Complete | Grant the exact copy/knowledge result once; no additional supply debit. |

A same-timestamp interruption that prevents any actual work does not trigger consumption. The allotment is **actual writing supplies representing the sourced 1 sp cost**, not automatic purchasing or conversion of coins into materials. This copying cost does not automatically apply to research.

Your roll interpretation is correct: [Core Rolls, line 29](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/c5cca832e082ed56e477e15188e6cbbf163a5f7c/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md#L29) applies task degrees and natural shifts, then collapses them to the research procedure’s binary outcome. No crafting quality, mishap, manufacturing XP or product effect follows.

For persistence, bind each attempt to its exact recipe/source version, evidence and method records, prior failed attempt where applicable, credited work intervals, supply disposition and once-only result. Authored legal work windows remain appropriate; these completions create no new day anchors or labor allowances.

thread.preview:
**Confirmed as a NEW provisional boundary completion**, with one clarification: evaluate research-check eligibility after the **existing automatic boundary sequence finishes**, not from a transient intermediate condition state.

Use this order:

1. **Credit eligible labor over the elapsed interval ending at T.** Conditions becoming effective at T do not invalidate work lawfully performed before T.
2. **Resolve the established condition, recovery and life-marker ordering at T.** This completion introduces no new global priority.
3. **Finalize the job appropriately:**
   - **Copying:** record completion once when its full hour was earned. Finishing the transcription requires no additional voluntary act or check. Incapacity prevents subsequent use; it does not erase that completed work.
   - **Research:** evaluate capability and required access against the resulting state. If eligible, perform the completion check using the modifiers then operative. If incapable, persist **FullyWorked/AwaitingCheck**, consuming no RNG and recording no success or failure.

For **AwaitingCheck**:

- Explicit resume revalidates the same lead, attempt, evidence access and other applicable prerequisites.
- It requires **no additional research hours**. This is an unresolved original attempt, not a retry.
- Use conditions and modifiers at the actual resumed check. Preserve the already-declared method and ability choice.
- A rejected resume spends no RNG. Once resolved, the attempt cannot return to AwaitingCheck or roll again.
- Waiting earns no labor and does not itself reserve additional worker hours.
- Keep ordinary completion automatic when already eligible; this state is not an optional way to defer a legal check for better modifiers.

Commit labor, boundary consequences, terminal/pending job state, any resolved RNG and the receipt atomically.

The decisive regressions are: final labor followed by incapacity gives **completed copy / awaiting research**; later legal resume rolls once without more labor; save/load preserves that distinction; and incapacity that appears and disappears within the established boundary sequence does not create a spurious interruption.

content.text: I accept the three completions in8ca1780b: feasible research/copy work retained; every retry full H with8 alternative-method hours included; copying consumes actual1sp supplies on first positive labor, no repeat charge/refund after work. I will bind recipe4 knowledge only, immutable evidence/method IDs, one supplied qualified lead and authored legal work windows. One exact scheduler boundary to settle: research/copy earns its final labor at exactly the instant a condition expires and its prior immunity ends, leaving the worker incapacitated. Existing shared ordering credits actual labor through instant, then condition expiry, recovery, virtual death saves. Proposal: credit final work first; copy completes from the finished transcription once (no new act/check); research still needs its completion check using conditions at that instant. If incapable at that check, persist fully worked AwaitingCheck and resolve once only on explicit resume after revalidating capability/evidence, with no extra hours or RNG reroll. Ended effects modify the actual check, not the prior labor. This avoids inventing incapacity retroactive work loss. Please confirm or amend this narrow new boundary completion.
